adjudication.rationale: The finding identifies a real issue in the migration. Looking at the migration code, it reads old `embeddable_hosts` values and inserts them directly into the new table without normalization. However, the old setting accepted URLs with 'http://' or 'https://' prefixes (as shown in the removed `allows_embeddable_host?` method in site_setting.rb which stripped these prefixes). The new `EmbeddableHost` model has a `before_validation` callback that strips 'http://' and 'https://' prefixes, but the migration uses raw SQL INSERT which bypasses model validations. This means if someone had 'http://example.com' in their old settings, it would be inserted as-is, but the new `host_allowed?` method compares against `uri.host` (just 'example.com'), causing a mismatch.
